_readme: This file is an EXAMPLE, and every value in it is the widget's built-in default.
It is overwritten on every deploy, so do not edit it in place - copy it.
TO USE IT: download this file, edit the values, save it as theme.json, and upload
theme.json to the SAME bucket, at the top level (next to widget.js). The widget reads
it on every page load, so a change is live within about a minute - no redeploy.
Deleting theme.json puts everything back to these defaults.
Keys this widget reads are listed below. Anything else in the file - including this
_readme - is ignored, and any single key it cannot understand is ignored on its own:
a typo in the colour leaves the colour alone rather than breaking the widget. The one
exception is a file that is not valid JSON, which is ignored entirely. Paste it into a
JSON validator if the widget does not pick up your change.
highlightColor - the one colour the widget is built from. It fills the header, the
launcher button, the Send button and your own chat bubbles, and tints the links.
A hex colour and nothing else - six digits ("#8a1c30") or three ("#a13").
Colour names ("maroon") and rgb() values are NOT read. The text drawn on top of it
is chosen for you - black or white, whichever is easier to read on your colour - so
there is no second value to set and no combination that comes out unreadable.
fontFamily - one of these five words, and nothing else. Fonts are not downloaded, so
the choice is limited to what every Mac and Windows machine already has:
"system"  - the visitor's own operating-system interface font (the default).
"sans"    - Arial / Helvetica.
"serif"   - Georgia / Times New Roman.
"mono"    - a fixed-width font (Menlo / Consolas).
"inherit" - whatever font the page the widget sits on is already using.
Only the typeface changes. Text sizes, weights and line spacing are fixed, because
they are what keep the panel readable when a visitor zooms in.
starterQuestions - the example questions offered under the greeting, before anyone has
typed anything. Up to FOUR per language, each up to 120 characters; extra or
over-long ones are dropped. "es" is optional - leave it out and Spanish visitors see
your English list, because nothing here is machine-translated. Remove the whole
starterQuestions block to keep the built-in questions in both languages.

en: How do I check out a book?
Where do I find my textbook?
es: ¿Cuál es el horario de la biblioteca?
¿Qué bases de datos de investigación hay?
